function Vo(e, t, n, l) {

    case "":
      return e;
    case "%":
      return l ? NaN : e / 100 * n;
    case "deg":
      return l ? e : NaN;
    case "grad":

    case "rad":

      return l ? e * 360 : NaN;

      return NaN;
  }

  }

          t.state?.onScrollableChange(this);
          break;

          throw new Error(`Table Layout don't have event ${e}.`);
      }
    });
  }

function vP(e, t) {
  const n = e.width * e.tileSize, l = e.height * e.tileSize, a = Math.min(t.w / n, t.h / l), o = n * a, r = l * a, s = t.x + (t.w - o) / 2, i = t.y + (t.h - r) / 2;
  return Object.freeze({
    scale: a,
    rect: Object.freeze({ x: s, y: i, w: o, h: r }),
    worldToDisplay(u, d) {
      return [s + u * a, i + d * a];
    },
    displayToWorld(u, d) {
      return u < s || d < i || u >= s + o || d >= i + r ? null : [(u - s) / a, (d - i) / a];
    },
    tileCenterToDisplay(u, d, m = 0, g = 0) {
      return this.worldToDisplay((u - m) * 16 + 8, (d - g) * 16 + 8);
    }
  });
}

      p = Fe(et, p.gameId), y = !1;
    }
  }
  const J = (F) => (..._) => n(async () => {
    if (!M()) return;
    const he = A();
    try {
      return await F(..._);
    } catch (we) {
      throw N(he) && (I = "操作未確認：" + we.message), we;
    } finally {
      q();
    }
  });
  function H(F = !1) {
    return !(w || E || Z()) || !F && i((d ? "複製遊戲" : "新建輸入") + "或原操作尚未完成。離開不會自動保存或取消服務操作；仍要離開？");
  }
  const P = Object.freeze({
    refresh: J(async () => {
      const F = A();
      await Ve(F), N(F) && !d && await Ke(F);
    }),
    create: J(j),
    // 重新載入後接著跑完手上那一筆原鍵（不建立第二份）。
    resume: J(async () => {
      v && await Q(A());
    }),
    // 失敗彈窗的「確認」：只關掉這筆結果，不改服務端任何事。
    dismiss() {
      !M() || l() || (p = null, I = "", q());
    },
    forget: J(async () => {
      try {
        s.removeItem(V());
      } catch {
        x = !0;
      }
      v = null, p = null, y = !1, I = "已清除本機追蹤；未取消或回滾任何在途請求，服務端結果仍以查詢同一個請求為準。";
    }),
    setField(F, _) {
      !M() || l() || !["name", "introduction"].includes(F) || typeof _ != "string" || (F === "name" ? w = _ : E = _, q());
    },
    gotoGame: J(async (F) => {
      const _ = A();
      C.some((he) => he.gameId === F) && H() && N(_) && await o(F);
    })
  });
  return Object.freeze({
    actions: P,
    render: q,
    canLeave: H,
    setIdentity(F) {
      if (b === F) return q();
      f++, b = F, p = null, C = [], w = "", E = "", I = "", y = !1, re(), q(), v && M() && P.resume();
    },
    pagehide() {
      f++, p = null, C = [], y = !!v, q();
    }
  });
}
